(Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Expedition Antarctica of extreme sports woman Caro North
programme.desc: Iceclimbing, ski mountaineering and sailing the open water for days through the infamous Drake Passage: The 28 years old extreme sports woman Caro North made her way to the very South of our continent for a four weeks expedition – accompanied by an eight-member crew. Antarctica turned out to be a paradise for extreme sports: deserted landscapes and snow-capped mountains against a surreal backdrop of ice and sea were waiting to be discovered.

programme.title: Lekkarod 2025
programme.desc: Depuis 10 ans, la Lekkarod est une course majeure du mushing en Europe. Affiliée aux fédérations nationale FFST et internationale IFSS, elle est une étape de la Coupe du Monde. Chaque année, une centaine de mushers et leurs chiens prennent le départ des 9 étapes de la Lekkarod, ou de celles des Trophées !For the past 10 years, the Lekkarod has been a major mushing race in Europe. Affiliated with the national FFST and international IFSS federations, it is a stage of the World Cup. Each year, around a hundred mushers and their dogs take part in the 9 stages of the Lekkarod, or those of the Trophies!

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: The Rise of the Hamminator Lindsey Hamm s journey from concrete to peaks
programme.desc: Mammut athlete Lindsey Hamm, a professional climber and mountain guide, brings a breath of fresh air to the world of mountaineering. Originally from Texas, she has begun making a name for herself in recent years. This short film offers a glimpse into her life, a recent expedition to Pakistan’s wild Charakusa Valley. Beyond the mountains, Lindsey is a people person, driven by a passion for inclusivity in climbing, and giving opportunities to other women, who want to get into the sport. She collaborates with womens organizations in Pakistan, helping to dismantle barriers and create opportunities for education and growth.

programme.title: New Zealand 9
programme.desc: In a race against time, three adventurers will set a new speed record by completing New Zealand’s nine Great Walks faster than they’ve ever been done before, using human power alone. It’s the ultimate adventure race. They’ll kayak 145 km, ride 80 km and run over 300 km in just nine days.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europe’s most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Ultra Vegans
programme.desc: For endurance athletes, getting the right diet can make the difference between success and failure. Many are now choosing to adopt a plant based regime and they are witnessing some remarkable results in terms of performance and recovery. Athletes, fitness coaches, sports nutritionists, ultra runners are sharing with us their experience and conviction wether they are motivated by self performance or animal wellfare.

programme.title: X-out Montenegro Eng
programme.desc: X-out Montenegro is part of the Xtri World Tour. Athletes starts with a 1.7 km open-water course. The race is started by the Xekutioner, a formidable figure who will be responsible for future eliminations. 15 of athletes will be eliminated by the Xekutioner, intensifying the competition. Eliminated athletes are given a time penatly and can then try to catch “The Splitter” to ovetake backmarkers and get back in the race! Then a tough and demanding 40 km asphalt cycle which climbs the famous serpentine above Kotor. Designed to test endurance to the max. Another 15 of athletes are eliminated by the Xekutioner here, ensuring only the toughest stay. Finally 6.5 km of downhill trail running and 2.5 km of “vertical” monster climbing. Again eliminated athletes have the opportunity to catch the leaders.

programme.title: Trans Sahara Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Trans Sahara Marathon. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Sahara Desert, this epic race, held in February 2025, challenges runners to traverse 150 kilometers across four grueling stages of unforgiving terrain. Drawing the worlds top athletes from every corner of the globe, the Trans Sahara Marathon is more than just a race; its a testament to the boundless limits of human potential and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: Trail Menorca Cami De Cavalls 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to a new edition of the Trail Menorca Camí de Cavalls Conecta Balear. 185 kilometers tracing the edge of a millennia-old island, blessed with unique natural beauty. Enchanted trails, towering cliffs, and dreamlike beaches shape one of the most demanding routes in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Trans Sahara Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Trans Sahara Marathon. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Sahara Desert, this epic race, held in February 2025, challenges runners to traverse 150 kilometers across four grueling stages of unforgiving terrain. Drawing the worlds top athletes from every corner of the globe, the Trans Sahara Marathon is more than just a race; its a testament to the boundless limits of human potential and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: Spartan Super World Championship 2025 Eng
programme.desc: High in Californias Sierra Nevada, the world gathers for a new test of endurance. This is the Spartan Super World Championship 2025, hosted by Mammoth Lakes, California. A race that starts at 2,400 metres above sea level and climbs higher still. Every athlete knows what waits ahead. 11 kilometres, 26 obstacles and the full force of the mountain.

programme.title: International Temiscamingue Raid Eng
programme.desc: The International Temiscamingue Raid is the first stage event to be part of the Adventure Race World Series, an international series that specializes in adventure races and which brings together the best endurance athletes in the world. Last September, athletes from Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Finland and Canada and seven local teams from Temiscamingue participated in the Raid Témiscamingue.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: Spartan Beast World Championship 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Spartan is back again to the culturally rich and visually intoxicating dunes of Abu Dhabi, UAE for the 2025 Spartan World Championship hosted by Abu Dhabi Sports Council. The Spartan World Championship weekend will include a variety of different World Championship races. A select group of top elites will battle for the 3K Elite World Championship title, while Elite and Age Group racers looking for a more grueling challenge will take on the qualification-based 21K Beast Championships.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: Cycling home from China Eng
programme.desc: Josh spent 4 months self filming his bike trip home from the Giant bike factory in Shanghai. During his 15 000 km trip between Shanghai China and Newcastle UK, he crossed 19 countries. A fantastic human adventure and a unique bike trip !

programme.title: Cycling home from China Eng
programme.desc: Josh spent 4 months self filming his bike trip home from the Giant bike factory in Shanghai. During his 15 000 km trip between Shanghai China and Newcastle UK, he crossed 19 countries. A fantastic human adventure and a unique bike trip !

programme.title: 12th Longines Equestrian Beijing Masters 2025
programme.desc: China. Beijing. A city where history breathes through every stone and shimmer of steel. Here, where dynasties once rode across vast plains, a new kind of cavalry takes the stage riders of precision, courage, and grace. Each autumn, the National Stadium, the Bird’s Nest transforms. Where Olympic legends once soared, hooves now thunder. This is the Longines Beijing Masters — the heart of Asian equestrian sport, and a meeting place for the world’s finest.

programme.title: Mongolia Horseback Archery World Championships 2023
programme.desc: For 2023, Mongolia and its capital Ulaanbaatar was brought in the spotlight of official horseback archery competition, that has grown a lot over the last few years in many places around the world. Everything started with the Spirit International HBA tournament in the beginning of September and this event would set the stage for the pinnacle one that was about to follow: the 2023 International Horse Archery Alliance World Championships.

programme.title: UIPM 2025 Obstacle World Championships
programme.desc: Beijing’s Olympic Centre turns into a proving ground as the UIPM Obstacle World Championships crown new stars across the 400 m, 3 K, and blistering 100 m sprint.

programme.title: Hokkaido Japan by bike - Part 3 Eng
programme.desc: Our bikepacker friend Michele is exploring the Japanese island of Hokkaido. On the agenda: volcanoes, forests, wilderness, brown bears, fishing owls, the Pacific Ocean, and weather that isnt always kind. Episode 3.

programme.title: UK Challenge 2025
programme.desc: Talent can win you the game, but its intelligence and teamwork that will win you the championship once, said the NBA basketball legend. That is Michael Jordan and hes right. And in this case, its the seven individual stages that are the games and the overall championship is the 2025 UK challenge. For the next three days and nights, nearly 70 teams will be putting themselves through what is the most mentally and physically demanding team building competition that youll see anywhere, and theyre all doing it for the challenge of building teamwork and the acclaim of picking up that overall Winners Trophy.

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2025 - Christmas Special Edition
programme.desc: We start this episode from Romania. In our previous episodes, we covered the exciting 2025 edition of Brasov Running Festival, highlighting the effort of the Elite 10k athletes. However, the Brasov Running Festival is much more than just the elite competitors. We then shift our focus to cycling, moving on to Turkey for another edition of LÉtape Türkiye by Tour de France. Moving from Turkey, we catch a flight to Croatia for Spartan Trail Dubrovnik. Since this is the last episode of the TV Show for 2025, we also got a glimpse of some of the most notable moments we enjoyed over the previous months.

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: Skoda Titan Desert Almeria 2025
programme.desc: Four intense days of mountain biking through Almería’s stunning landscapes — from coast to desert, across sand, hills, and rugged trails. Amateurs and pros alike face the heat, the wind, and their own limits. More than a race, it’s an adventure of endurance, camaraderie, and pure adrenaline beyond the stopwatch.

programme.title: Cape To Cape 2025 Eng
programme.desc: 800 riders have assembled for the 17th edition of the Australian Cape To Cape mountain bike stage race. Starting at Cape Leeuwin lighthouse and finishing four days later up at Cape Naturaliste, the course makes its way through a network of trails along the coast, through National Parks, forest, farm lands, mountain bike parks, and bush before heading up to the northern cape of the South West WA region. Roughly 200km and 2,500m of climbing in total, each day’s riding is between 34km and 59km and has its own special terrain and environment to keep things interesting with a mix of fast flowing single trail, farm tracks, groomed downhill trails and fire trails.

programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn 2025
programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn is a 7-day, 800km full-service gravel stage race through South Africa’s diverse landscapes. Starting in coastal forests, the route heads into the breathtaking Great Karoo – a vast, spectacular semi-desert region. Riders rest each night in remote ‘Burn Camps’ under star-filled skies and, on the final day, greeted by Africa’s iconic Big 5 wildlife.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Women 2026
programme.desc: 9th edition of the Womens Tour Down Under, which is the part of the 2026 UCI Womens World Tour.

programme.title: Cro Race 2025
programme.desc: The 2025 CRO Race is a road cycling stage race (6 stages - 900 km) in Croatia held between 30 September and 5 October 2025. It is the tenth edition of the Tour of Croatia since its revival in 2015 and the sixth under the CRO Race name. The race is rated as a category 2.1 event on the 2025 UCI Europe Tour calendar

programme.title: Inside Desertus Bikus Eng
programme.desc: Josh partcipates to Desertus Bikus, an ultra cycling race that crosses Spain and Portugal starting in Hasparren in the Basque Country and finishing in Setubal Portugal. Josh is cycling during 1400 km across desert areas, villages, gravel tracks and asphalt roads.

programme.title: 2025 Aus Cycling MTB Enduro National Championships
programme.desc: A rain-soaked Collie, Western Australia, becomes the stage for Australia’s premier Enduro showdown, where world-class Wambenger Trails and the iconic Wellington Dam mural frame a weekend of grit, flow and community. Across Juniors, Masters, Adaptive and E-bike fields, riders wrestle slick rock, pea gravel and long liaison climbs as stories of resilience emerge. The result is a kinetic, human-centred portrait of Australian MTB: fast, muddy, inclusive, and unforgettable.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Dakhla - Morocco 2025
programme.desc: A full roster of 28 men and 16 women, from a total of 16 countries around the world, are set to join the line-up in Dakhla for five days of intense action that could have a key bearing on who takes the titles. Reigning world champions, France’s Capucine Delannoy and Brazil’s Gabriel Benetton, top the Kite-Surf rankings as they head to the season’s penultimate stop in Dakhla, Morocco, on the Sahara desert’s coastline.

programme.title: SFT Wake Foil E-Foil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, will make history this autumn as it hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: Taíba, Brazil, host the final stop of the GKA Kite World Tour 2025. The world’s top riders will take to Taíba’s powerful Atlantic waves for four days of action-packed competition that will determine the men’s and women’s world titles. The event marks the thrilling conclusion to a season that has already visited Cape Verde, Dakhla, and Sylt.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2025 - Episode 12
programme.desc: In our previous episode Italy was on the spotlight. The world’s top WingFoil racers were building up towards the most important event of the season, the first ever Formula Wing World Championships. We also attended Dutch Water Week, that is the premier celebration of sport and water in Netherlands. We will start this episode from Brazil where the Wingfoil Racing World Cup roared back to life on Brazil’s north-east coast, launching its season finale. We will also travel to Turkey, where the Bosphorus turned into a sea of color and pride as the 6th Presidential International Yacht Races concluded with its grand finale. Leaving action aside, we will travel to Malta for for the Malta Boat Show.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: All The Way Eng
programme.desc: From award-winning documentary filmmaker Carl Eneroth at Sthlm Social Innovation Lab comes "All the Way". A heart-pounding, intimate and mind expanding portrait of Swimrun team Pontus Lindberg and George Bjälkemo, as they prepare for their ultimate challenge… winning the 75 km ÖtillÖ Swimrun World Championships in the Stockholm archipelago… in trail shoes and a wetsuit.

programme.title: 2025 ROLEX New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup
programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. Since the event was first run in 2009, it has attracted top amateur sailors from 51 of the world’s most prestigious yacht clubs from 23 countries.

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: GKA Hydrofoil Big Air World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2025
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers.

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Alone And Without A Guide On Mexico s Third Highest Mountain-Iztaccihuatl Eng
programme.desc: Being alone and without a guide in a summit attempt for the third highest mountain in Mexico was a dream. The climb is amazing. The ridge to Iztaccihuatls summit feels endless, but the views of the surrounding valleys and Popocatepetl make the effort worth it.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: Grand Teton Loop Eng
programme.desc: Grand Teton National Park is a stunning and iconic park in the US, known for its majestic Teton Range, beautiful lakes, and diverse wildlife. In July of 2022, Jeff and Audrée made a stop on their way back to Canada while on a road trip to Colorado, so that they could run a 38 mile / 62 km loop around the park, which mile for mile would be one of the most scenic and beautiful routes theyve ever run.

programme.title: Lekkarod 2025
programme.desc: Depuis 10 ans, la Lekkarod est une course majeure du mushing en Europe. Affiliée aux fédérations nationale FFST et internationale IFSS, elle est une étape de la Coupe du Monde. Chaque année, une centaine de mushers et leurs chiens prennent le départ des 9 étapes de la Lekkarod, ou de celles des Trophées !For the past 10 years, the Lekkarod has been a major mushing race in Europe. Affiliated with the national FFST and international IFSS federations, it is a stage of the World Cup. Each year, around a hundred mushers and their dogs take part in the 9 stages of the Lekkarod, or those of the Trophies!

programme.title: Summiting Mt Sneffels in Colorado Eng
programme.desc: Mount Sneffels is a prominent mountain near Ouray, Colorado in the United States which is over 14,000 feet high, more than 4,300 metres. Audree had never climbed a 14er, so we decided to try reach its summit while on a road trip through Colorado in late-July.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata In The Dolomites Climbing Possnecker Eng
programme.desc: Cris and Viv climb Piz Selva, a 2,941m mountain belonging to the Sella group, an iconic giant of the Dolomites.They start their hike from Passo Sella, and their chosen route was via Ferrata Possnecker (also called Ferrata delle Mesules), one of the oldest Via Ferratas in the Dolomites.

programme.title: The Rise of the Hamminator Lindsey Hamm s journey from concrete to peaks
programme.desc: Mammut athlete Lindsey Hamm, a professional climber and mountain guide, brings a breath of fresh air to the world of mountaineering. Originally from Texas, she has begun making a name for herself in recent years. This short film offers a glimpse into her life, a recent expedition to Pakistan’s wild Charakusa Valley. Beyond the mountains, Lindsey is a people person, driven by a passion for inclusivity in climbing, and giving opportunities to other women, who want to get into the sport. She collaborates with womens organizations in Pakistan, helping to dismantle barriers and create opportunities for education and growth.

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing
programme.desc: Margalef is a little village next to the Monsant river, in Catalunya. The most amazing rocks in Europe and hundreds routes for climbing. Pure fun and climbing in this little entertaining film.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europe’s most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Josh is in Cyprus voor een lokaal verkenningsavontuur op het eiland en gaat op roadtrip van Nicosia naar een verlaten attractiepark, een asbestmijn en een scheepswrak.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Cody is samen met Lexi Limitless in de 'Big Easy' om New Orleans te verkennen en bezoekt een verlaten liefdadigheidsziekenhuis voordat hij Brutus, de gigantische alligator, ontmoet.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: Aan weerszijden van de wereld proberen Adam en een lid van de Zuid-Afrikaanse crew hun angsten te overwinnen.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: Terwijl Xander en zijn crew de bush intrekken, ontdekken ze de mooiste aspecten van Zuid-Afrika: nationale parken, safari's en wilde dieren.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Er is geen plek op aarde met zo’n rijke culturele diversiteit als Papoea-Nieuw-Guinea. Bill volgt het spoor van de legendarische koppensnellers diep het regenwoud in en ontdekt geheimen die nog mysterieuzer zijn.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash’ reis langs de Chinese Muur begint op het meest oostelijke punt, bij een eeuwenoud deel dat bekendstaat als de Chu-Muur. Daarna reist Ash naar de Shaolintempel in de stad Dengfeng om kennis te maken met hun eeuwenoude gebruiken.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Vanaf Old Dragon’s Head trekt Ash westwaarts, waar hij een Muurbeschermer ontmoet die zijn leven heeft gewijd aan het behoud van dit iconische bouwwerk. Daarna maakt hij zich op voor een onverwacht avontuur: duiken bij de onder water gelopen resten van de Chinese Muur.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash is aangekomen in Peking, waar hij Terry Townsend ontmoet om meer te leren over natuurbescherming in de regio rond de Chinese Muur. Ook ontmoet hij twee andere Muurbeschermers en proeft hij lokale lekkernijen in het dorp Shi Xia.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan speurt naar gevallen van mystiek en lokale folklore. Als tegenhanger van het macabere besluit hij zijn eigen schoonheidswedstrijd te organiseren in de stad Iloilo.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan stuit op een marketingcampagne rondom shoe-dating en gaat op drie unieke dates om Kuala Lumpur te verkennen. Later komt hij diep in Sarawak in een onverwachte situatie terecht.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan stuitert als een flipperkastbal door Hanoi, verkent eeuwenoude fabels, proeft exotische gerechten en helpt MAG International bij het verwijderen van niet-ontplofte munitie.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: De broers liften vanuit de oude Inca-hoofdstad Cuzco langs de ruggengraat van de Andes naar het Titicacameer. Ze krijgen te maken met ernstige hoogteziekte, kauwen op cocabladeren om op krachten te blijven en ontmoeten lokale bewoners terwijl ze zich een weg banen door het Andesgebergte.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Voor hun reis door Egypte kiezen de broers een felucca, een eeuwenoud handelsvaartuig. Ze varen noordwaarts over de Nijl, van de oasestad Aswan naar de oude stad Luxor, voordat ze een gigantische zandduin ontdekken waar ze vanaf glijden.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Lapland is een bevroren winterland vol rendieren, Sami-tradities en sauna’s. De broers beginnen in Stockholm en vliegen 200 kilometer recht naar het noorden, boven de poolcirkel. Hun vervoermiddel voor deze reis: een rendierslee.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: Terwijl Adam vecht tegen een golf van droefenis, beleven Xander en zijn team een Afrikaanse safari te paard, waarbij ze spectaculaire wilde dieren en adembenemende savannes bewonderen.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: Van de Echogrotten tot het historische Pilgrim's Rest, Xander begint zich weer thuis te voelen op de regio in Zuid-Afrika waar hij is opgegroeid.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: Terwijl Xander en zijn team genieten van heerlijke gerechten en wijn bij het wijnhuis Spier, brengt Adam zijn dag door met het maken van cider en doorzoeken van familiebezittingen.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Volg Bill terwijl hij een immens middeleeuws fort bezoekt dat doet denken aan de Verboden Stad. Van reusachtige grafheuvels en nieuwe olympische locaties tot bewegend voedsel – Bill gaat op zoek naar de ziel van dit moderne, eeuwenoude land.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: De meest waanzinnige duik beleeft hij echter wanneer hij tientallen haaien voert – zonder enige bescherming. In een poging dat op land te overtreffen, sluit Bill een ongelooflijke deal met een lokale stamhoofd om te filmen op een plek waar nog nooit eerder is gefilmd… Het Verboden Eiland.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Het echte Madagaskar kent geen pratende leeuwen, zebra’s of nijlpaarden. Wat het wél heeft, is de meest unieke verzameling planten en dieren op aarde. Bill trotseert het nauwelijks toegankelijke terrein om een zeldzame dansende lemuur te vinden – en een andere die zingt.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: In zijn zwaarste uitdaging tot nu toe waagt Ash zich aan Eagle’s Neck – een berucht steil en gevaarlijk stuk van de Chinese Muur. Maar eerst ontmoet hij technologie-experts die helpen de Muur digitaal in kaart te brengen, met als doel haar te beschermen.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Langs het westelijke deel van de Muur reist Ash naar Binnen-Mongolië om daar een nomadenfamilie te ontmoeten en zich te wagen aan Mongoolse worsteltechnieken. Hij hoopt het Naadam-festival bij te wonen, waar paardrijden – een belangrijk onderdeel van de Mongoolse cultuur – centraal staat.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash trekt de woestijn in om Wu Xinlei te ontmoeten, een survival-expert. Hij wil begrijpen hoe het voor de mensen moet zijn geweest die de Chinese Muur in dit afgelegen en onverbiddelijke landschap bouwden.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: In de meest dichtbevolkte stad ter wereld probeert Jonathan inzicht te krijgen in de nieuwe sociale dynamiek van een moderne samenleving.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Tijdens de Sengoku-periode was Japan het rijk van krijgers: samoerai, ronin en ninja’s. Jonathan duikt het verleden in om de nog altijd springlevende tradities van het Bushido te onthullen.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Een seizoen vol hoogtepunten! Presentator Jonathan Legg blikt terug op zijn beste momenten uit het tweede seizoen van Road Less Traveled, onthult unieke inzichten uit de bestemmingen en deelt nooit eerder vertoond beeldmateriaal.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Rampen en triomfen maken deze reis onvergetelijk. De broers beginnen met een bijna-dodelijk bootongeluk in de zuidelijke Filippijnse Zee, maar weten zich te herstellen en bereiken uiteindelijk hun doel: het dorp Donsol, de walhaai-hoofdstad van de wereld.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: In deze aflevering vermijden de broers de bekendere plekken zoals Tokyo en Kyoto en trekken ze naar het afgelegen, eeuwenoude eiland Shikoku. Hun route volgt de historische 88 Tempel Zen-pelgrimstocht.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Per pick-uptruck verkennen de broers het cultureel en geografisch rijke eiland Cape Breton en de beroemde Cabot Trail. Hummervissen, vishaken, elks spotten, bingo, Schotse ceilidhs, Mi'kmaq-trommelsessies – alles komt voorbij in deze aflevering.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: Een wijnboerderij omringd door bergen, een dag wandelen inclusief picknicken, en verrukkelijk eten in combinatie met eersteklas wijn staat op het programma voor Xander en zijn team op hun route van Grabouw naar Botrivier.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Niets op aarde is te vergelijken met Mongolië. Hier trekken de laatste nomadische volkeren met hun vee over miljoenen hectaren grasland. Bill drinkt gefermenteerde merriemelk (volgens hem het smerigste drankje ooit), rijdt op een jak en spoort het oorspronkelijke wilde paard op.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Het team vaart met een ijsbreker naar de Noordpool, net op tijd om Bill’s moeder via een satelliettelefoon te bellen en haar een gelukkige verjaardag te wensen (ze is zo verbaasd dat ze hem niet herkent). Ondertussen volgen en filmen ze de grootste roofdieren op aarde… ijsberen.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash bevindt zich in de laatste etappe van zijn reis langs de Chinese Muur. Nadat hij de bouwtechnieken van de Muur heeft bestudeerd, trekt hij verder de Gobiwoestijn in, naar het betoverende Crescent Lake – een prachtige oase tussen zandduinen.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Na een weerzien met een oude vriend van de Chu-muur bezoekt Ash enkele indrukwekkende stenen structuren – zowel natuurlijke als door mensenhanden gemaakt – in het Yardang Nationaal Park en in Xiaofang City. Met een laatste telefoontje naar huis komt er een einde aan zijn reis langs de Chinese Muur.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan begint zijn reis in Californië met een ruige 4x4-doorsteek door de Mojave-woestijn, vol spookstadjes en gevaren. Uiteindelijk maakt hij zijn weg naar Las Vegas, waar een geheel nieuwe reeks avonturen op hem wacht.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan begint zijn reis in Californië met een ruige 4x4-doorsteek door de Mojave-woestijn, vol spookstadjes en gevaren. Uiteindelijk maakt hij zijn weg naar Las Vegas, waar een geheel nieuwe reeks avonturen op hem wacht.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan onderzoekt het concept van duurzaam toerisme in Cambodja; hij gaat op een junglepatrouille met Wildlife Alliance en belicht het verhaal van de illegale stroperij- en handelindustrie.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan onderzoekt het concept van duurzaam toerisme in Cambodja; hij gaat op een junglepatrouille met Wildlife Alliance en belicht het verhaal van de illegale stroperij- en handelindustrie.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: De broers bereiken hun doel door op motorfietsen naar het hart van Nicaragua te rijden. Ze doorkruisen de jungle naar afgelegen stranden aan de Pacifische kust en reizen landinwaarts door Spaanse koloniale steden, lokale dorpen en het immense vulkanische eiland Ometepe.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1
programme.desc: Eric Hanson gaat heli-hiken en verkent grotten terwijl hij Canada’s eerste en meest populaire nationale park en het naburige Lake Louise ontdekt.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Bill trekt door eindeloze modder, dichte vegetatie en steile bergen om oog in oog te staan met onze machtige verwanten – de gorilla’s. Hij volgt ook het leven en ontdekt de restanten van het kamp van een van zijn helden: Dian Fossey.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Botswana is een droom voor natuurliefhebbers, met enorme kuddes olifanten, reusachtige groepen nijlpaarden en enkele van de grootste leeuwentroepen ter wereld. Het is ook de thuisbasis van de Victoriawatervallen – de grootste waterval ter wereld.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash’ reis langs de Chinese Muur begint op het meest oostelijke punt, bij een eeuwenoud deel dat bekendstaat als de Chu-Muur. Daarna reist Ash naar de Shaolintempel in de stad Dengfeng om kennis te maken met hun eeuwenoude gebruiken.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Vanaf Old Dragon’s Head trekt Ash westwaarts, waar hij een Muurbeschermer ontmoet die zijn leven heeft gewijd aan het behoud van dit iconische bouwwerk. Daarna maakt hij zich op voor een onverwacht avontuur: duiken bij de onder water gelopen resten van de Chinese Muur.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash is aangekomen in Peking, waar hij Terry Townsend ontmoet om meer te leren over natuurbescherming in de regio rond de Chinese Muur. Ook ontmoet hij twee andere Muurbeschermers en proeft hij lokale lekkernijen in het dorp Shi Xia.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5
programme.desc: Jonathan blikt terug op een door de pandemie getroffen productiejaar en deelt ongeziene beelden, inzichten en momenten achter de schermen uit seizoen 5 tot nu toe.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: In een land waar werkelijk alles mogelijk is, is Jonathan niet verbaasd vrouwen in uiteenlopende rollen en posities aan te treffen, maar de extremen zijn schokkend divers en volledig onverwacht.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Italië in de zomer is toeristisch tot op het bot... maar kan Jonathan nog steeds het minder bewandelde pad vinden?

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Josh verkent de buurt in Armenië en de hoofdstad Yerevan, bezoekt enkele verlaten Sovjet gebouwen, een breifabriek en een luxe hotel.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Josh is terug in Gary, Indiana, voor een lokale verkenningstocht. Samen met vrienden bezoekt hij een voormalige bank, het gedenkauditorium en treinstation Union.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: In Epic Exploring: Going Local wordt Zagreb, Kroatië bezocht. Cody vuurt een kanon af in de oude toren, verkent een nooit afgebouwd universiteitsziekenhuis en een politiekschool.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Stel je een kroegentocht voor langs 26 pubs, verspreid over 7 dagen en 60 mijl! Tijdens een traditionele ramble door de adembenemende Yorkshire Dales in Noord-Engeland trekken de broers door heidevelden, dalen, pieken en valleien – met benen én lever nog intact.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Vanuit Marrakesh nemen de broers een reeks lokale Berber-taxi’s over het High Atlasgebergte en dalen af in de Draa-vallei, totdat de weg eindigt aan de rand van de eindeloze zandzee van de Sahara, waar ze een verborgen schat begraven.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Op weg naar het uiterste noorden, naar de Arctis, om de traditionele cultuur en het indrukwekkende leven van de Inuit te ontdekken, vergezellen de broers een oudere en een jonge jager op een 200 mijl lange sneeuwscootertocht over het barre land en bevroren zee-ijs.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Fietsen is doorgaans een veilige en ontspannen bezigheid – totdat je het doet in de wildernis van Kenia, tussen leeuwen, olifanten en buffels.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1
programme.desc: Bill had twee wilde iconen die hij per se wilde meemaken. De eerste: de grootste hagedis ter wereld – de Komodovaraan. Tussen deze reusachtige beesten lopen was op zijn zachtst gezegd zenuwslopend. De andere: de enige mensaap van Azië – de orang-oetan.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: In het adembenemende Lago di Garda waagt Jonathan zich opnieuw aan een paraglidemanoeuvre die hem vorig jaar bijna het leven kostte. Bij zijn vertrek kiest onze presentator voor een zenuwslopende route over de majestueuze Dolomieten, helemaal tot in Zwitserland, om daar een stad te bezoeken die letterlijk met de klok meedraait rond één enkel doel.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3

programme.title: Rethink S1

programme.title: More Curious? S1

programme.title: More Curious? S1

programme.title: More Curious? S1

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1

programme.title: Combat Countdown S1

programme.title: Combat Countdown S1

programme.title: Combat Countdown S1

programme.title: Battle Factory S1

programme.desc: Polyethyleen wordt afgemeten, gevormd, verwarmd en gekoeld om een robuuste container te maken die uit vliegtuigen kan worden gedropt en sterker is dan zijn houten voorgangers. programme.title: Battle Factory S1

programme.desc: Een iconisch mes dat al meer dan honderd jaar deel uitmaakt van de militaire cultuur, het Zwitsers zakmes, dat over de hele wereld wordt ingezet — zelfs in de ruimte.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.sub-title: Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish
programme.desc: Om te ontdekken hoe zijn favoriete maaltijd — fish & chips gevolgd door rijstpudding — wordt gemaakt, bezoekt Lord Prescott de Ambrosia-fabriek in Devon om het productieproces van klassieke Britse desserts te verkennen. Daarna reist hij terug naar het noorden, naar Grimsby, waar hij bij de Young’s-fabriek leert hoe hun beroemde vispastei wordt gemaakt.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.desc: Op zoek naar de ultieme Britse combinatie — thee en biscuits — reist Lord Prescott naar Liverpool, waar hij de Typhoo-theefabriek bezoekt en ontdekt wat er nodig is voor een perfect gezet kopje thee. Terug in Yorkshire stopt hij bij de Fox’s-biscuitsfabriek, waarmee hij zijn reis afsluit met een echte Britse traktatie.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.desc: Op een nostalgische reis om twee van zijn jeugdfavorieten te herontdekken bezoekt Lord Prescott de Ribena-fabriek, waar hij ziet hoe de iconische zwartebessensiroop wordt gemaakt — met 90% van de zwartebessen uit het VK. In Herefordshire bezoekt hij vervolgens de Tyrrells-fabriek en ontdekt hij hoe een kleinschalig landbouwbedrijf zijn eigen aardappelen verwerkt tot ambachtelijke chips.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1
programme.desc: De McVitie’s-fabriek in Carlisle, Cumbria, opent haar deuren en laat zien hoe miljoenen van ’s lands favoriete koekjes worden gemaakt — 24 uur per dag — in een van de grootste fabrieken van Groot-Brittannië én de oudste koekjesfabriek ter wereld.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1
programme.desc: Van het maken van verse spaghetti en het mengen van de geheime ingrediënten voor de saus tot gigantische geautomatiseerde kranen en de nieuwste robots: ga vandaag nog aan de slag bij de Heinz-fabriek en maak samen met de machines van morgen blikken met favoriete producten voor thuis.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1
programme.desc: Ontdek wat er allemaal bij komt kijken om tot wel 5 miljoen cakes per dag te maken, waaronder French Fancies, Angel Slices en Bramley Apple Pies. Maak kennis met de ingenieurs die de machines 24/7 draaiende houden, de medewerkers die de cakes produceren en de operators die dagelijks met ultramoderne robots werken.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Non-Stop Party
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en fyr, der jagter sin kæreste til Jordens ende og LMFAO, der ikke kan holde op med at feste.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Severed Head Showcase
programme.desc: En gospel-gruppe må øve sig uden deres lærer, en gruppe krigere fejrer en halshugning, en fange forsøger at narre fængselsvagten og en ung mand bliver konfronteret fordi han kun taler i floskler.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meagan's Fight
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer, at Meagan vender tilbage, Jordan prøver at se cool ud på en stripklub og optræder med et funkshow.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Michael Jackson Halloween
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan fejrer Halloween ved at flygte fra racistiske zombier, skuespillerne i 'Human Centipede' har en skræmmende genforening, og vi besøger en folkeskole for troldmænd med problemer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Black Ice News
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Samuel og Lashawn, der glæder sig over fordelene ved deres nu lovlige ægteskab, en politibetjent, der møder sin nye makker og Lando fra 'Star Wars' bliver forfulgt af en superfan.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Les Miz
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer vikaren fra den indre by Mr. Garvey og A-Aron, Jordans kæreste tager ham i at se porno og fyrene laver sjov med Les Mis.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor
programme.desc: En kildeleg mellem to venner bliver mærkelig, forfattere brainstormer til 'Gremlins 2', to bøller mistænker deres ven for at stjæle og Keegan og Jorden diskuterer Afrika til en fest.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Airplane Showdown
programme.desc: En steward skal håndtere en passager, som ikke vil spænde selen, britiske opdagelsesrejsende diskuterer deres rejser, to par forsøger at undgå spoilers på en dobbeltdate og en bibelgruppe oplever en guddommelig intervention.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dubstep
programme.desc: Præsident Obama og hans vredesoversætter, Luther, taler til Mitt Romney, vi møder manden, der skulle tale efter Martin Luther Kings 'I Have A Dream'-tale, og to venner taler om, hvad der sker med deres bæ, efter de skyller ud.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Parole Officer Puppet
programme.desc: En tilsynsværge bruger en dukke til at knytte bånd til en i hans varetægt, en mand med nakkestøtte prøver at feste løs og en soldat har en følelsesladet genforening med sin familie.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Das Negroes
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan forsøger at gemme sig fra en negerjagtende nazist. Andre sketches inkluderer to slaver, der har svært ved at blive solgt, et par bøller, der kommer i knibe før et stort kup.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Biological Dad
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer et rumvæsen, der lærer om kvindelig anatomi, fyrene der prøver at overgå hinanden og mødet mellem de to sidste mennesker på Jorden.

programme.title: Key & Peele: A Cappella Club
programme.desc: En PSA arbejder med børnesoldater i Afrika, en college-a-cappella-gruppe får et nyt medlem, Meegan og André går på deres første date, en terrorgruppe har en foodtruck og to gamle mænd diskuterer popmusik.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrible Henchman
programme.desc: En nødsituation tvinger en mand til at ændre sit morgen, en håndlanger ødelægger det for superskurken og Jordan minder Keegan om, at han er voksen nu.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The End
programme.desc: Ray Parker Jr. har nogle nye sange, en mand kan ikke lade være med at sige 'deez nuts', Keegan må ringe til 112 og en ung mand lærer om Negrotown.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Landlord
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen vil præsident Obama behandles ligesom alle andre, Jordan ser på en lejlighed, som er ejet af en mistænksom vicevært og et par festaber, der vil få gang i festen til en bar mitzvah.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Detective
programme.desc: En respekteret kriminalbetjent, ekspert i sexforbrydelser, bruger ukonventionelle metoder for at løse en sag, en actionhelt redder sin kæreste og en ansat i en forretning med yoghurtis tester for mange vareprøver.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Old Ladies And Satan
programme.desc: To gamle damer slås mod Satan, ting går galt når en mand vil købe en ny madras og gæsterne på en klub tvinges til at se sandheden om sig selv.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Concussion Quarterback
programme.desc: En fodboldspiller med hjerneskade prøver at inspirere sit hold, en mand anklager sin kone for at være utro med en hund og en restaurantejer skræmmer sine gæster væk.

programme.title: Key & Peele
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan har en flickerkamp og en MMA-fighter går for vidt, når han disser modstanderen. Andre sketches inkluderer en bryllupsgæst, der vil være dj og spille 'klassiske' numre.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Killer Concept Album
programme.desc: En politiker benægter at have sendt frække fotos, en detektiv forhører en rapper, Cedric og Levi finder lyn i en flaske, to herrer fra Syden komplimenterer kvinder, Jordan møder en gammel ven og en betjent tager tingene bogstaveligt.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer at fyrene har en dårlig Skype-forbindelse, en Django Unchained-slavekamp og en baseballspiller, der klasker røv for meget.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Manly Tears
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en narkohandel, der går galt, en mafiafyr, der er en stor tudemarie, og Darius Rucker, der prøver at håndterer sin Hootie-fortid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrorist Meeting
programme.desc: A gangster prøver desperat at bevise, han er skør, terrorister mødes for at planlægge deres næste træk og en jaloux storebror gør en familiemiddag pinlig.

programme.title: Key & Peele: East West Bowl #2
programme.desc: Sketcherne inkluderr en introduktion af de nyeste East/West Bowl-spillere, udlejer-Devon ransager Jordans lejlighed, og Jordan bliver stødt af en overseksuel kollega.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bone Thugs And Homeless
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en hund, der plager en nyhedsreporter og Harriet Tubman, der løber frit omkring.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Soul Food
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan diskuterer, hvem der er mest sort og når man er den eneste sorte fyr til en fest. Sketches inkluderer Tea Party, der opdager et nyt håb, hærens hververe, der tænker anderledes, og Bobby McFerrin, der dyster mod Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dueling Magical Negroes
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan spiller to mystikere, der kæmper om rettigheden til at give skarpsindige råd. Andre sketches inkluderer Jaden Smith og hans agent, der diskuterer et nyt manuskript og et bøssepar, der 'fejrer' ny lovgivning.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Alien Imposters
programme.desc: Rumvæsner invaderer jorden, en familie forliger sig med en slægtnings homobryllup og nogle racister udtrykker nogle overraskende meninger.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Joke Stealing
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en fodboldspiller, der bliver straffet for at juble for meget, Jordan og Keegan går til premiere på 'Othello' og en high school-elev bliver berømt for at stjæle en vittighed.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sexy Vampires
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en uhyggelig asiatisk spøgelsesbofælle, fyrene ser på den lyse side af tortur og Keegan oplever et hus fyldt med sexede vampyrer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Y'all Ready For This?
programme.desc: Et football-hold hyper sig før en kamp, president Obama og Luther møder Hillary Clinton, to fyre forbereder sig på potentielle trusler på et fly, pirater synger en sang og en betjent er lidt for skydeglad.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Scariest Movie Ever
programme.desc: A vampyr afslører sig selv, en seriemorder bliver bremset og et barn får sit ønske opfyldt.

programme.title: Key & Peele: MC Mom
programme.desc: En gangster deltager i et skuddrama, en mor skriver en sang til sin søn, to bondefangere konkurrerer, Big Boi møder André 3000 og to fyre kommer ud for et biluheld.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Pussy On The Chainwax
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Keegan, der bliver distraheret, mens han taler i telefon med sin kæreste, Keegan og Jordan har en ond chef og tilblivelsen af et nyt udtryk.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The 420 Special
programme.desc: Neil deGrasse Tyson slapper af derhjemme, Keegan må bevare fatningen under et jobinterview, en skrædder får en klient med luft i maven, parkeringsvagterne diskuterer 'Game of Thrones' og en telefonsælger prøver en ny strategi.

programme.title: Key & Peele: I'm Retired
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en polterabend, der bliver mærkelig og en sort fyr med en hvid penis.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings
programme.desc: Inkluderer sketcher hvor Keegan og Jordan aflytter hvide kvinder, der elsker sorte mænd, Wendell laver en musikvideo, og Kareem og Jahar går i fitnesscenteret.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass: In Recovery
programme.desc: En baseballspiller kæmper mod sin afhængighed af at klaske røv, en mafioso tager hævn og Steve Urkel driver en mand til vanvid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Branding
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan udforsker oplevelsen som sort collegestuderende og snyltegæster, som succes medfører. Andre sketches inkluderer et kvartes reaktion på et mystisk væsen, hvornår man kan - og ikke kan - sige et kontroversielt ord.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Job Interview
programme.desc: Dommer Jessie har et nyt program, en mand venter på sit jobinterview, to damer sludrer, parkeringsvagter diskuterer Val Kilmer, en pensioneret mand fra hæren hører om et nyt projekt og en kvinde introducerer sin forlovede for sine forældre.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Addict Wendel
programme.desc: Artister bliver sparket i skridtet på grund af deres kunst, klassens klovn terroriserer læreren og en mand prøver at få heldet med sig til et møde for sexmisbrugere.

programme.desc: David Duchovny and Minnie Driver star as a widower and a waitress who seemed to be destined to fall in love.

programme.title: Mystic Pizza
programme.desc: Three young women sling pizza and dream of a future far away from Mystic, their small town.

programme.title: Nicholas Nickleby
programme.desc: Nicholas Nickleby sets off on an adventure to reunite his broken family in Dickens' beloved novel come to life

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: Seven gunslingers face an army of marauding bandits in this classic starring Yul Brynner and Steve McQueen.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: A hotel manager risks his life and his family to take in over 1,000 refugees during the 1994 Rwandan genocide.

programme.title: Midnight Cowboy
programme.desc: A con man and a naïve hustler from Texas try to survive on the unforgiving streets of New York.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: A college boy finds his hometown is not so normal when he discovers a human ear in a field.

programme.title: Showgirls
programme.desc: Passion and power struggles unfold when a young woman will do anything to make it as a Las Vegas showgirl!

programme.title: River's Edge
programme.desc: A powerful portrait of disaffected teens based on the horrifying real-life murder of a young California girl.

programme.title: The Misfits
programme.desc: In their final screen roles, Clark Gable and Marilyn Monroe are at their luminous best in this piercing drama.

programme.title: Barbershop (2002)
programme.desc: Ice Cube headlines a stellar cast this hit comedy about a southside Chicago barbershop.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®.

programme.title: Lilies Of The Field
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier stars as an itinerant handyman who stops to help five impoverished nuns in the Arizona desert.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones (1958)
programme.desc: Two convicts on the run are bound together by an unbreakable chain and separated by unbridled hatred.

programme.title: Some Like It Hot
programme.desc: In this madcap farce, two Chicago musicians disguise themselves as women to avoid the mob.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: The brutal assault at the hands of a racist cop will inform the life of Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson, "Hammer"), who will grow up to become the reigning head of Harlems black mafia in "Black Caesar."

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars in this powerful, pull-out-the-stops crime thriller that pulsates with high-octane energy and nonstop suspense as Truck Turner tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles. Nichelle Nichols also stars.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, the black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. Three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Fled tracks two prison escapees (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) on the lam as they race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk that could either bring down the Cuban Mafia or get the two killed.

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Julie (Claire Danes), Pete (Giovanni Ribisi) and Linc (Omar Epps) are three problem teens headed to jail...until Captain Greer (Dennis Farina) offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene. It’s a case that the cops can’t crack, but when Greer sends in his new task force – The Mod Squad – they quickly uncover a crime ring involving drugs, hookers...and dirty cops!

programme.title: Death Wish II
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is no victim: He fights back – with a vengeance! After beginning a new life in L.A., Kersey's daughter is viciously assaulted. Now, he won't rest until he tracks the assailants down...and puts them all in the ground!

programme.title: Death Wish 3
programme.desc: A battle-weary Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) longs to leave his fighting days behind him. But when he arrives in New York to visit a friend and finds him brutally attacked, the silent avenger must wage war again in this no-holds-barred thriller!

programme.title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

programme.title: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
programme.desc: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancee (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

programme.title: Over The Top
programme.desc: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

programme.title: Convoy
programme.desc: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

programme.title: Kalifornia
programme.desc: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: Kalifornia
programme.desc: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Body Of Evidence
programme.desc: After a night of unbridled passion, Rebecca Carlson (Madonna) finds herself on trial for murder. Now it's up to her attorney (Willem Dafoe) to prove her innocence...but the road to the truth may prove to have as many curves as his seductive client!

programme.title: The Hot Spot
programme.desc: A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

programme.title: Miami Blues
programme.desc: Fred Ward, Alec Baldwin and Jennifer Jason Leigh star in this deliciously offbeat black comedy about a murdering thief, his streetwalker-gone-straight wife and the denture-wearing cop who is closing in on his trail. Nora Dunn co-stars.

programme.title: Harsh Times
programme.desc: Christian Bale, Freddy Rodriguez and Eva Longoria star in this gritty look at friendship, loyalty and ambition set on the rough streets of South-Central Los Angeles as an ex-Army Ranger (Bale) attempts to come to terms with life after the military.

programme.title: Breaker! Breaker!
programme.desc: Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

programme.title: Good Guys Wear Black
programme.desc: Action superstar Chuck Norris stars as John T. Booker, the former leader of an elite commando unit who must uncover the reason why his former squad members are being systematically murdered one by one. Anne Archer and James Franciscus co-star.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Lone Wolf Mcquade
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

programme.title: Firewalker
programme.desc: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

programme.title: Code Of Silence
programme.desc: Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A.
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

programme.title: Raju Chacha

programme.title: Kya Super Kool Hai Hum

programme.title: Shahenshah Of Bollywood-83rd Birthday Special Vol 2
programme.desc: Iconic melodies of Amitabh Bachchan reflecting romance,pride, and cinematic brilliance.

programme.title: Nun's Cookbook
programme.desc: The temple chefs make butterbur miso. Just boil butterbur shoots, then grind with sugar, mirin and white miso. The taste is slightly bitter, but perfect for early spring.

programme.title: CINEMATIC JOURNEY
programme.sub-title: Hiking the San'in Coast Endless Beauty
programme.desc: The San'in Kaigan Geopark Trail is a 230-kilometer-long course connecting the Sea of Japan coastline along Tottori, Hyogo, and Kyoto prefectures, which was designated as a UNESCO Global Geopark. Canadian actor Kyle Card embarks on a journey through time to uncover the ancient forces that shaped this coastline.

programme.title: Time-lapse Journey
programme.desc: Iwate Prefecture is home to many historic sites which were made to represent Buddhist paradise. Chuson-ji Temple in Hiraizumi, a World Heritage Site, is home to the golden Konjikido hall which offers a prayer for peace. The garden in Motsu-ji Temple was made as a depiction of paradise and has been also registered as a World Heritage Site. Catch a glimpse of eternity through time-lapse photography.

programme.title: The Masterpieces of Ukiyo-e producer Tsutaju
programme.desc: This miniseries presents the masterpieces of Tsutaju, a brilliant ukiyo-e producer of the Edo period. This episode takes a close look at artist Utamaro's iconic "Woman with a Glass Noisemaker."

programme.title: Direct Talk
programme.sub-title: Exquisite Creations Inspired by Nature: Hosono Hitomi / Ceramic Artist
programme.desc: Hosono Hitomi's botanically themed ceramics are highly acclaimed and held in museum collections across the world. She talks about her intricate designs and unmatched technique.

programme.title: One in Every Japanese
programme.desc: A hike can turn unsafe very quickly. In 2023, Japan saw a record high of 2,761 mountain accidents. We follow a veteran hiker lost and injured for six days, revealing how he ultimately survived.

programme.title: One in Every Japanese
programme.desc: In Japan 6.7 million or one in 19 seniors aged 65+ live alone. In a remote village, the only grocery shop supports the elderly living alone. We find out why one widowed woman is happiest now.

programme.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE
programme.sub-title: Braving the Rain and the Currents
programme.desc: Caught in an evening shower, Edo townspeople scramble across a bridge in search of shelter. On the river beyond, a lone figure steers his boat, unfazed by the rain. What is his destination? *"Sudden Shower over Shin-Ohashi Bridge and Atake," from the series "One Hundred Famous Views of Edo" (1857) by Utagawa Hiroshige

programme.title: Backstage Japan

programme.title: Seasoning the Seasons
programme.desc: Hakodate, a port city located in southern Hokkaido, is known for having one of the best night views in Japan. As the surrounding seas darken, the lights of the city warm the hearts of dwellers. Beneath each light lies the lives of citizens. As the winter cold chills Hakodate, the city shines even brighter.

programme.title: Journeys in Japan
programme.sub-title: Hokkaido: Voices from the Northern Land
programme.desc: Through the generations, Hokkaido has been home to people from diverse backgrounds, who have developed their livelihoods and established distinctive cultures in each area. Confronting the harsh natural environment of this vast northern island, the inhabitants have poured their feelings — joy, anxiety, prayers and wishes — into songs that are cherished to the present day. Those songs continue to bring local communities together through shared memories and values. On this edition of Journeys in Japan, British photographer Alfie Goodrich visits areas of Hokkaido that are home to the following songs: Esashi Oiwake, Soran Bushi, Tokachi Uma-uta, Hokkai Bon-uta and the Upopo songs of the Ainu people. Through this soundscape so deeply rooted in each community, he explores Hokkaido's history, culture and local traditions.

Those songs continue to bring local communities together through shared memories and values. On this edition of Journeys in Japan, British photographer Alfie Goodrich visits areas of Hokkaido that are home to the following songs: Esashi Oiwake, Soran Bushi, Tokachi Uma-uta, Hokkai Bon-uta and the Upopo songs of the Ainu people. Through this soundscape so deeply rooted in each community, he explores Hokkaido's history, culture and local traditions.

programme.desc: Pop Paper City is the capital of a captivating paper world where a group of unique paper friends live. Together they use craft to solve challenges and complete their adventures. Season 1, episodes 31 & 32.

programme.desc: Pop Paper City is the capital of a captivating paper world where a group of unique paper friends live. Together they use craft to solve challenges and complete their adventures. Season 1, episodes 33 & 34.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Farmer's Llamas
programme.desc: Shaun spies three prank-pulling llamas at a Country Fair and tricks the Farmer into buying them. Back at Mossy Bottom Farm, mischief ensues. When things start to spiral out of control, Shaun has to take action to oust the llamas and save the farm.

programme.title: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
programme.desc: During the British Raj, upon witnessing the atrocities of the British, Bhagat Singh grows up to be a fierce freedom fighter. His publicised ideas of revolution bring him to as much popularity as Mahatma Gandhi amongst Indians.

programme.title: Khakee
programme.desc: DCP Anant and his team are assigned to escort an alleged terrorist from Chandangarh to Mumbai. His seemingly simple mission turns into a deadly encounter of survival when a rogue ex-cop turned criminal hinders his way.

programme.title: Baatein Kahi Ankahi
programme.desc: Watch Baatein Kahi Ankahi with RJ Anmol In An Exclusive Interview With Bollywood Stars.

programme.title: Waqt Ki Awaz
programme.desc: Lata runs away from home in order to avoid an arranged marriage fixed by her father. She chances upon and falls in love with a truck driver named Vishwa but she is left devastated when he gets arrested for murdering a man.

programme.title: Khuda Gawah
programme.desc: An Afghani Pathan Baadshah Khan falls in love with Benazir, the queen of a rival clan, and proposes marriage to her. She agrees to marry him only on one condition- he has to murder her father’s killer in India.

programme.title: Gair Kaanooni
programme.desc: Kapil's (Shashi Kapoor) wife dies of a heart attack when her baby boy gets stolen and is replaced with another infant in the hospital. Traumatised after losing his family in one single day, Inspector Kapil fights his case in court. But when the matter doesn't resolve the way he wishes to, he takes the help of a convict to get to the bottom of it.

programme.title: Aankhen
programme.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. To make the robbery untraceable, he trains three blind men to do the job for him.

programme.title: Aankhen

programme.title: Global Baba
programme.desc: A criminal transforms himself into a spiritual guru after being betrayed by a political leader. He soon succeeds in attracting a large number of followers, manipulating society and establishing a position of power in politics.

programme.title: Accident On Hill Road
programme.desc: While driving home under the influence of alcohol, Sonam hits a man crossing the street and the impact throws him onto the windshield of her car. Fearful of the consequences, she decides to conceal her crime which changes her life forever.

programme.title: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programme.desc: A group of Indian POW (Prisoners of War) from the 1971 Indo-Pak war rebels against the Pakistani army and tries to escape from their captivity. Helping the group in the mission is Gaurav, the son of a former Army Major also held captive by the enemy.

programme.title: Shool
programme.desc: A diligent Police Inspector Samar is transferred to a small town swarming with corruption and moral decay. As he begins to straighten things up, he attracts the unwanted attention of corrupt politician who becomes a threat to Samar and his family.
